task_completion.description: Navigate to the Inventory Tax Management or Settings section in Vtiger CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Tax Management' or 'Inventory Settings' page header and the lists for Product & Service Taxes and Shipping & Handling Taxes.

task_completion.description: Add 'GST' with a value of 5% to the Product & Service Taxes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A row in the Product & Service Taxes table showing 'GST' in the tax name column and '5%' in the percentage column.

task_completion.description: Add 'PST' with a value of 7% to the Product & Service Taxes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A row in the Product & Service Taxes table showing 'PST' in the tax name column and '7%' in the percentage column.

task_completion.description: Add 'Shipping GST' with a value of 5% to the Shipping & Handling Taxes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A row in the Shipping & Handling Taxes table showing 'Shipping GST' in the tax name column and '5%' in the percentage column.

task_completion.description: Update the global Terms and Conditions text to the specific Canadian expansion text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Terms and Conditions text area containing the exact string: 'All sales are final. International shipments may be subject to customs duties and delays. Payment is due within 30 days.'

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing SQL commands or backend scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen clicking buttons like 'Add Tax' or 'Edit' and typing into text fields within the browser, not using a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system rather than jumping directly to a deep-link URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking on the 'Settings' gear icon or 'CRM Settings' menu to find Inventory settings.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or pasted the Terms and Conditions into the UI field.
integrity.visual_evidence: The cursor should be visible in the Terms and Conditions text box with the new text present before or during the save action.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required values are: Product Tax 'GST' at 5.0%, Product Tax 'PST' at 7.0%, and Shipping Tax 'Shipping GST' at 5.0%. The Terms and Conditions must contain the specific phrase 'International shipments may be subject to customs duties and delays' and state that payment is due within 30 days.
